results.detail: Most units match (classification, level 1, Add 0 no-op, dedupe, unknown values, Custom Fields, mobile/e-mail rules, create attributes batch 10, UPDATE parameter positions 0-43, log path conditions). Two problems. (a) Unit 35 says that without a fill-in the CRM values are written back. Update Correct Value uses gen_recordsorceDB == 1 && ISNULL(<db>) && !ISNULL(<file>) ? new : DB. If gen_recordsorce is NULL in CRM, the CRM mobile/e-mail is empty and the file has a value, the condition evaluates to NULL and, per documented SSIS expression behaviour (not shown in the files), a NULL condition makes the ?: result NULL; the UPDATE (Param_18-31) then writes NULL into that channel's last-update date, source, transmission status (and transmission date/file/feedback/error) instead of the CRM values. (b) Written values omitted: Create Contact also writes gen_modifiedbybank = DateTime.Now (main.cs 119), and the ContactBase UPDATE also writes gen_modifiedbybank = GETDATE(), ModifiedOn = GETDATE() and ModifiedBy = system user (Param_10).
